Original r003 horizontal main-fork shelf is absent; a visible faceted junction swelling remains. Single-parent containment is not universal and is disclosed for independent review.

Crown has asymmetric projected spread and real separated leaves; not a billboard.
Geometry alone retains trunk, crown volume and small upper sporangia; moderate junction bulges remain visible, not hidden by color.
